title: Flight overview map slide (o-my-debrief MissionMap port)
description: Analysis station now opens on a Leaflet flight-overview map (FlightTrackMap.svelte ported from o-my-debrief MissionMap): dashed ground track from location data, flown trail following timeline playback, heading-rotated aircraft marker, overview stats strip (duration, max alt/speed/g, track nm, caution time). D3 plot builder moved behind an analysis slide / Open data plots toggle. Captured sig events render as severity-colored markers on the track with click-to-recall. Location data upgraded from random walk to heading/airspeed-integrated ground track in demoData.js and the Python generator (sample files regenerated, ~4nm circuit). Validated headless: 7-step workflow passes with zero console errors.

title: Time-based snippet entry: start time + duration/end time + timeline markers

Capture modal now shows the time window instead of percentages. Validated headless: 30s duration, minute units, explicit end time, and end-marker drag all pass with zero console errors.
